channel.title: Text :: Pages
channel.description: Expressions over strings. Eight children: Anchor, Anchorage, Beacon, Compass, Drift (linked as Signal), Ember, Lantern (hidden) and Ösen. Their weights run 10, 15, 20, 30, 35, 40, 50, 60 and deliberately disagree with the alphabet: Beacon is lightest, Ösen heaviest. Lantern weighs 15 and only shows where hidden pages are asked for. Every grouped listing here sets headinglevel="4" so that a group heading renders below the heading naming the listing, rather than beside it.

item.title: Beacon
item.description: Carries the lower-case twin of the tier Anchor carries.

item.title: Lantern
item.description: Hidden from the menu unless hidden says otherwise.

item.title: Anchor
item.description: Shares its first three letters with Anchorage.

item.title: Anchorage
item.description: Splits from Anchor only at the fourth letter.

item.title: Compass
item.description: A second guide, so that group is not a synonym for page.
